title: Perplexity signs a multiyear deal with CoreWeave to use dedicated clusters powered by Nvidia Grace Blackwell chips for AI inference; CRWV jumps 5%+ pre-market (Ina Fried/Axios)
summary: Ina Fried / Axios: Perplexity signs a multiyear deal with CoreWeave to use dedicated clusters powered by Nvidia Grace Blackwell chips for AI inference; CRWV jumps 5%+ pre-market — Perplexity has signed a multi-year deal with CoreWeave to help power a new generation of services, the AI cloud computing company shared first with Axios.
